Before creating a volunteer account, please contact our Volunteer Coordinator, Kristin Cordaro, to discuss current volunteer needs and available opportunities. Call: (706)922-8382  Email: Kristin.Cordaro@uss.salvationarmy.org

content:wysiwyg_basic:6:14.html:
Mandated Community Service

The Salvation Army of Augusta offers opportunities for individuals seeking to complete mandated community service requirements. To apply, please submit the form below. Our volunteer coordinator will contact you to discuss available shifts and assignments.

Please note:

  • There is no need to register an account. Simply submit the form below to apply.
  • Availability for community service shifts is limited, and spots are filled on a first-come, first-serve basis.
  • Community Service Workers must be 18 years of age or older.
  • If you require assistance with the online form or have any questions, please contact our Volunteer Coordinator at (706) 922-8382.

Submit the Form Below to Apply:

Fill Out Form
